sourceArticle.title: OpenAI launches $4bn Deployment Company with TPG, Advent, Bain, and Brookfield
sourceArticle.author: Ana-Maria Stanciuc

athenaOutput.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine will continue to prioritize and develop sovereign, self-hosted, and owned AI solutions, adhering strictly to Article I of its Constitutional Laws.
athenaOutput.rationale: The OpenAI Deployment Company, as described, represents a third-party service model for deploying proprietary AI models within enterprise environments. This approach directly contradicts the Creative Liberation Engine's foundational principle of sovereignty (Article I), which mandates a preference for self-hosted and owned solutions. ATHENA's prior decisions consistently reinforce this commitment, focusing on building internal capabilities and maintaining control over our AI infrastructure and deployment. Engaging with or adopting a strategy akin to OpenAI's Deployment Company would necessitate reliance on external entities and their intellectual property, which is antithetical to our core architectural and strategic directives.
